text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal, or an object. Another key task is object detection, which means finding and locating several objects in one image at the same time. Computer vision has many real-world applications. For example, it is used in medicine to study X-rays, in security cameras to detect strangers, and in self-driving cars to recognise roads, signs, and other vehicles. Thanks to computer vision, machines can "see" and make smart decisions.
